compose_reports_ambiguous: Multiple compiler functions match this node; no compiler flags were attached.
compose_reports_no_match: No compiler function matched this node.
compose_reports_static_hint: Static compiler analysis only; not measured recomposition counts, timings, or jank evidence.
compose_reports_omitted_parameters: {count} additional parameters omitted from this view.
compose_reports_shortened: Long compiler values are shortened in this view; the source reports are unchanged.
compose_reports_purpose: Compiler reports describe restartable and skippable composables, parameter stability, and class stability. Importing them supplements matching runtime nodes with compiler flags and available unstable-parameter details, helping identify code to investigate.
compose_reports_configure_hint: For Kotlin 2.x projects with org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose already applied, add the following top-level block to each Compose module's build.gradle.kts, outside the android block. reportsDestination enables the importable reports; metricsDestination optionally enables aggregate statistics.
compose_reports_generate_hint: Run this command from the target project root. Replace app and Release with the module and build variant containing the target composables. This compiles without packaging an APK; :app:assembleRelease also generates reports. On Windows, use gradlew.bat. If compilation is UP-TO-DATE but reports are missing, append --rerun-tasks.
compose_reports_output_hint: Look in app/build/compose_compiler and any variant or target subdirectories for *-composables.txt, *-composables.csv, and *-classes.txt. Names use the module prefix. metricsDestination also produces *-module.json statistics, which this importer does not read.
compose_reports_import_hint: Return to Layout Inspector and click Import Compose Reports in the bottom status bar. Choose Report File to select any one of *-composables.txt, *-composables.csv, or *-classes.txt; reports with the same module prefix in that folder are imported together. Or choose Report Folder and select the folder directly containing the reports. Import does not scan subfolders or read APKs. Use reports from the same source revision and build variant as the inspected app.
compose_reports_limitations: Reports are optional static compiler diagnostics, not measured recomposition counts, timings, or jank evidence. An unstable parameter does not necessarily prevent skipping, especially with strong skipping. Node matching uses function names and source filenames when available; same-named functions can be ambiguous. Importing a report does not enable full Compose inspection for a non-debuggable app.
